scope: Links, formulas against source, saved numerical results and status only. No training, evaluation or GPU use.
formula_review: Hard screening matches operators.oblique_factors: N=U R_K, B=Sigma_K^-1 Q_K.T; ES=S is direction preservation, not preservation of S.T z for every input.
Soft angle matches saved-basis operator: weight=s/max(s*s,sin(45deg)^2); no general idempotence.
Reference comparison uses U U.T with mean or frozen per-input donor and does not enforce D S=0.
Learnable HeadEditor matches V.T z, W detach(r), sigmoid gate and V-space delta; fixed N/S/NS basis dimensions and parameter totals checked.
Latest engine online_self uses raw current head detach when external reference is None; learned_self uses a separate unedited pass.
Training formula matches per-node correctness indicator KL, case-averaged original nodes, per-type paired averaging, JS and label-oriented hinge with margin one.
status_review: Completed previous M3 reports and selected epoch 1 for both variants; P0-P3 documented from committed stage report plus timestamped read-only progress snapshot; miniature validation excluded from formal completion.
